description: Search for car rental options between cities. Find available vehicles with pricing, specifications, and rental terms for specific dates and locations. Use when the user wants a rental car for given pickup and drop-off places and dates. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, times HH:MM. To give a booking link for the car the user chose, pass request_id and the car's referenceId to car_allocate.

driver_age.description: Driver age (minimum 18; defaults to 25 if the user didn't say)

sort_by.description: Sort criteria: 'recommended', 'price_asc' for cheapest first, 'price_desc' for most expensive first, 'distance' for nearest first, 'review' for highest rated, or 'review_count' for most reviewed

trip.description: Trip type: 'domestic' for local or 'international' for cross-border travel

name: car_search
title: Search rental cars
